newsitem.title: UK: Securicor prison staff suspended after death.
newsitem.headline: Securicor prison staff suspended after death.

text.p: The Prison Service on Wednesday suspended the right of six members of Securicor Group Plc's staff to work with inmates after an inquest found that lack of care contributed to the death of a prisoner in their charge.
But it said in general lay observers have found that Securicor has "exercised a consistently high standard of prisoner care" since it started prisoner escorting services in 1994.

The service said in a statement that Peter Austin died by hanging at Brentford Magistrates Court in West London on January 29. It said the inquest on Wednesday "found that a lack of care contributed to his accidental death".

"In the light of the inquest verdict and the criticisms of the Securicor staff on duty at the time of Mr Austin's death, the Prison Service is today suspending the certificates of six Securicor staff," the statement said.
"This will prevent them continuing to work with prisoners. We will be considering whether these certificates need to be revoked." -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
